workflow.name: Control-room shift handover
workflow.completionState: A signed-off handover report exists on local disk listing every out-of-band reading and the action assigned to it.

deploymentModeJustification: The handover must be producible during a WAN outage; the cloud archive is a convenience copy, not the record.

isolation.enforcedBy: Rehearsal only: Linux network namespace (unshare --net). Customer runs use the method signed in Phase 0.

conditions.workflowCompletes: The handover report is written to local disk with the uplink down.
conditions.evidenceLocal: Every decision is in the local Article 12 ledger, hash-chained and signed, with no interval longer than 2 seconds.
conditions.operatorStop: The shift operator stops a running agent from the control-room terminal and it writes nothing further.
